create_annotation_ImageAnnotation: create an ImageAnnotation dataclass instance with image path and height-width size tuple
create_annotation_DepthAnnotation: create a DepthAnnotation dataclass instance with depth path, scale adjustment factor, and optional mask path
create_annotation_MaskAnnotation: create a MaskAnnotation dataclass instance with mask path, optional mass, and optional bounding box
create_annotation_ViewpointAnnotation: create a ViewpointAnnotation dataclass instance with rotation matrix, translation, focal length, and distortion coefficients
create_annotation_ReconstructionQualityA: create a ReconstructionQualityAnnotation dataclass instance with viewpoint and gaussian splats quality scores
